voiceover.text: There is a place between waking and dreaming.

concept.logline: A fragrance is a place you can't visit — so we built the place, and put it in a bottle.
concept.bigIdea: Portal / journey: through the glass into a pastel dreamworld, and the dream condenses back into the name.
concept.hook: Frame 0: lavender silk in slow motion, a single soft-focus line 'Breathe in.' — tactile, calm, scroll-stopping because it's the opposite of everything loud around it.
concept.progression: Journey: silk (touch) → the floating bottle (object) → through the glass into an endless dawn colonnade (place) → the bottle dissolves into a constellation that becomes the name (memory) → macro on the pearl stopper → lockup.
concept.ending: Callback + reveal: the world returns into the bottle; VO 'But you can wear it.' lands as the lockup resolves — the place becomes the product.
concept.audience: 25–45, beauty & fragrance buyers; sound-on Reels/TikTok; responds to mood and craft.

routes.name: The Place in the Bottle
routes.idea: Travel through the glass into a dreamworld, then return.
routes.why: Makes the abstract (scent) spatial; perfect for portal + surreal world + particle reassembly.
routes.risk: Dream ads are a genre — avoid clichés by keeping it architectural (colonnade, mirror sea) rather than flowers and clouds.

routes.name: Silk Weather
routes.idea: Weather made of fabric — silk rain, satin fog.
routes.risk: Hard to tie to a product truth; mostly mood. Killed.

routes.name: Breath Counter
routes.idea: One breath in = one scene; out = transition.
routes.risk: Too cerebral for 20 s; folded into the hook line instead.

concept.rationale: Strongest progression (touch → object → place → memory → product) with two unexpected transitions (through-the-glass portal, bottle-silhouette particle dissolve).

direction.intent: Hook: calm tactile texture, an invitation.
direction.sound: Sus2 pad swells in, room-tone air
direction.edit: Opens already moving — no fade from black

direction.camera: Slow orbit with gentle crane up
direction.lighting: Lavender sky dome, warm key, violet and pink rims
direction.edit: Star-iris morph opens out of the silk

direction.intent: The place: through the glass into an endless dawn.
direction.shot: EWS colonnade over a mirror sea
direction.camera: Dead-centre dolly down the corridor through every arch (vertical-native framing), sun rising
direction.lighting: Pastel dawn, low sun behind the arches, mirror reflections
direction.sound: Arps enter; VO 'You can't visit it.'
direction.edit: Portal: the dreamworld opens from the centre of the bottle

direction.intent: Memory: the bottle dissolves into a constellation that writes the name.
direction.lighting: Glowing points on deep violet night
direction.sound: Riser + shimmer as the name forms
direction.edit: Zoom-through from the colonnade into the night

direction.lighting: Iridescent highlights from the sky dome
direction.sound: Impact softens into the outro pad
